title: Interfere MCP & CLI
summary: Connect your agents to Interfere with the new MCP server, inspect problems from your terminal with the CLI, and build your own integrations with a typed SDK.
body_markdown:
We’re launching our brand new MCP server and CLI that lets agents introspect and action on your Interfere workspace.


Your agent can then look up problems, sessions and releases, and more. If you’d rather the agent can’t make changes, use the read-only endpoint at` /mcp/readonly` .


We’re also rolling out plugins for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex over the coming weeks, pending approval, additionally enabling your agent to investigate recent errors or find the sessions a problem affected.


The CLI gives you the same actions as the Interfere UI in your terminal. For example, you can run` interfere problems inspect` to see a problem’s details, timeline and findings in one place.


You can install the MCP by adding` https://mcp.interfere.com/mcp` to your agent, and the CLI with` npm install -g @interfere/cli` .


Additionally, we’re launching our Platform SDK,[@interfere/javascript](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@interfere/javascript) , to make building custom integrations easier.
